title: Existing-position exit rules
description: evaluate_exit_flags() in app/portfolio/exits.py: flags a held position for SELL/reduce independently of the fresh-entry signal logic (stop hit, 2%/6% rule breach, profit-zone + Impulse Red, tide flip to bearish).

checklist.step: Flag 'stop_hit' when price closes below the position's protective stop
Flag 'two_percent_rule_breached' / contribute to 'six_percent_rule_contributor' using portfolio-risk-rules output
Flag 'profit_zone_impulse_red' when price reaches the upper Autoenvelope band with Impulse turning RED
Flag 'tide_flipped_bearish' when the weekly tide flips from BULLISH to BEARISH for a currently-long position
Confirm a HOLD signal from signal-engine-orchestration does NOT suppress any of these exit flags (verify-elder-signal checklist)
Write unit tests covering each flag independently and in combination
Run pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing and confirm no regression
